title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 8.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 8.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to import Git repositories into projects despite administrator restrictions. This occurred due to missing authorization checks under certain conditions. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
